NEW FINDING (outside Correction Order 010's original 2-item scope, discovered via real end-to-end execution, not unit tests): running control_plane.py for real (dry_run=False) against the now-correctly-pointed isolated webhook produced HTTP 200 with body {"status":"file_error","message":"No file(s) found"} from the real n8n gateway -- because TaskQueue.add() writes queue items to whatever queue_dir was passed (a temp dir in this test), not to .automation/tasks/, which is where the real n8n workflow's 'Read Task File' node looks. Separately, N8NGateway.verify_response() does not actually check whether response['status'] indicates success or failure (it only checks for the PRESENCE of a status field and, if present, a matching task_id) -- so this file_error response was treated as valid and the pipeline proceeded to report COMPLETED anyway, using only CUE's own submit-time stub evidence, never anything genuinely written by the real gateway. This means C1's control_plane.py, as it stands, has never actually completed one real end-to-end cycle through the real isolated n8n webhook -- every 'success' so far (dry_run unit tests, and this manual real-mode run) was internally self-consistent but did not depend on a real successful gateway response. This is a genuine integration gap, not a blocker for closing the 2 original Correction Order 010 items, but it must not be mistaken for proof that the real n8n integration works.
